+ public - private (# in JavaScript) hollow triangle: inheritance dashed arrow: dependency

g.title: note
g.text: Feature groups are not separate inheritance hierarchies.
Private means # in JavaScript. Base abstract contracts are enforced at runtime.
Functions in oop/polymorphism.js: dashboardPath(account) calls getDashboardPath();
recordSummary(record) calls getSummary(). These dispatchers are functions, not classes.
